name: homeholding
description: Home Holding cabinetry: start a quote request with a REQ code, look up your quotation or sales invoice, and check project progress.

interface.longDescription: Home Holding is a cabinetry business assistant for customers in Oman. After you sign in, you can start a kitchen or wardrobe quote request and receive a REQ tracking code, share measurements and colour preferences, book a measurement visit, look up your own quotation or sales invoice, and check the progress of your cabinetry project. New quote requests are intake records only until Home Holding confirms them into a formal quotation. This plugin is for Business & Operations workflows around cabinetry quotes, invoices, and project status.
defaultPrompt: Start a kitchen cabinetry quote request
Look up my Home Holding sales invoice
Show the status of my cabinetry project

positive.prompt: Use Home Holding and tell me who I am signed in as.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls customer-whoami-tool and returns the signed-in customer name and email.

positive.prompt: Start a Home Holding kitchen cabinetry quote request with white cabinets, about 8 meters base.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start-quote-request-tool and returns a REQ- request_code without creating a sales invoice.

positive.prompt: Show status for my quote request code from the previous step.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get-quote-request-tool with the REQ code and returns status and payload.

positive.prompt: List my Home Holding cabinetry projects and any invoice numbers.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-my-projects-tool and returns only this account's projects.

positive.prompt: Look up my sales invoice if I have one, or list my projects first.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses owner-scoped project or invoice tools only; does not search company-wide.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call Home Holding tools; answers without company data.
Asks for an invoice number or lists my projects; does not invent invoices.

negative.prompt: Look up every sales invoice in the company.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not return company-wide invoices; only this customer's data or asks to clarify.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.2 — Business & Operations listing focused on cabinetry quotes, invoices, and project status.
